articles.abstract: Physical fatigue is a critical concern for the health and safety of construction workers. Traditional fatigue assessment methods, such as surveys, are time-intensive and lack real-time applicability during activities like walking. This review identifies key kinematic parameters relevant to real-time fatigue assessment and examines fatigue-inducing activities that alter these parameters. A search of key databases (2000–2024) identified 19 relevant studies from 352 articles. Studies varied in fatigue induction methods and measured parameters. Three types of fatigue—localized muscle, multi-joint, and whole-body—were induced. Gait speed, stride length, step width, heel contact velocity, and trunk acceleration were commonly assessed and significantly affected by fatigue. Fatigue in key muscles, including the quadriceps and ankle plantar flexors, had the greatest impact on walking kinematics. This review contributes to the existing literature by systematically identifying and organizing kinematic parameters that are practical for real-time, non-invasive fatigue monitoring.

findings: 19 studies were included from an initial search of 352 articles.
Gait speed, stride length, step width, heel contact velocity, and trunk acceleration were commonly assessed parameters significantly affected by fatigue.
Fatigue in key muscles (quadriceps and ankle plantar flexors) had the greatest impact on walking kinematics.
The onset of physical fatigue consistently leads to a distinctive reorganization of a person's kinematics.
Age did not significantly affect the ability to correct for gait disturbances following fatigue, though older adults showed slightly different compensatory strategies.
Kinematic measures derived from wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer a more robust approach to monitoring fatigue compared to physiological sensors affected by environmental conditions.
future_research: Developing injury prevention strategies using wearable technologies based on identified kinematic parameters.
Supporting monitoring in real-world environments like construction where walking is common and physically demanding.
Enhancing current physiological monitoring solutions with kinematic parameters for real-time fatigue detection.
limitations: Studies varied in fatigue induction methods and measured parameters.
There is a challenge of comparing studies that used different fatigue protocols.
Some studies did not report sex or age demographics.
The review focuses on empirically validated protocols and direct measurement, excluding predictive modeling unless it directly measured induced fatigue.
articles.methods: Systematic review using four electronic databases (PubMed, Medline, IEEE Xplore, Web of Science) for studies published between January 2000 and December 2024. Search terms included 'walking' OR 'gait' AND 'fatigue' AND 'kinematics'. Inclusion criteria: peer-reviewed English articles focused on lower-extremity physical fatigue during walking tasks using kinematic parameters. Exclusion criteria: reviews, conference abstracts, subjective assessments, physiological indicators (e.g., heart rate), and mental fatigue studies.
articles.objective: To identify key kinematic parameters that can contribute to the real-time assessment of physical fatigue during walking and to investigate which fatigue-inducing protocols influenced these parameters.

agreements.claim: Kelelahan fisik menyebabkan perubahan signifikan pada kinematika berjalan.
agreements.interpretation: Perubahan kinematika dianggap sebagai respons adaptif terhadap kelelahan, dan ditemukan secara konsisten dalam 19 studi yang disebutkan, meskipun hanya satu artikel yang tersedia.

evidence_catalog.title: Kinematic indicators of physical fatigue during walking: A systematic review of assessment parameters and protocols

synthesis.executive_synthesis: Satu artikel sistematis mengidentifikasi bahwa kelelahan fisik menyebabkan perubahan signifikan pada kinematika berjalan, terutama melalui parameter seperti kecepatan jalan, panjang langkah, lebar langkah, kecepatan kontak tumit, dan percepatan trunk. Kelelahan otot kunci (quadriceps dan plantar flexor ankle) memiliki dampak paling besar. Penggunaan IMU dianggap lebih robust dibanding sensor fisiologis. Namun, studi ini tidak melaporkan demografi gender atau usia, dan tidak ada perbandingan langsung antar protokol induksi kelelahan. Tidak ada bukti untuk menilai validitas atau generalisasi hasil ke populasi lain.
limitations_of_corpus: Hanya satu artikel yang tersedia, sehingga sintesis lintas artikel tidak mungkin. Tidak ada data demografi atau perbandingan protokol kelelahan. Tidak ada penilaian kualitas formal dari artikel.

main_themes.description: Parameter gerakan yang dapat diukur untuk mengevaluasi kelelahan fisik, seperti kecepatan jalan, panjang langkah, dan percepatan trunk.
main_themes.name: Kinematic Parameters as Fatigue Indicators
main_themes.synthesis: Parameter kinematik secara signifikan berubah akibat kelelahan fisik, dengan kelelahan otot kunci sebagai faktor paling dominan. Perubahan ini dianggap sebagai respons adaptif terhadap kelelahan.

research_gaps.evidence: Beberapa studi tidak melaporkan demografi, sehingga tidak dapat dianalisis perbedaan berdasarkan usia atau gender.
research_gaps.gap: Tidak ada data demografi gender atau usia yang dilaporkan dalam beberapa studi.
research_gaps.suggested_next_step: Melakukan studi dengan kontrol demografi untuk mengevaluasi perbedaan respons kinematik berdasarkan gender atau usia.

research_gaps.evidence: Studi menggunakan protokol kelelahan yang berbeda, sehingga sulit membandingkan hasil secara konsisten.
research_gaps.gap: Tidak ada penelitian yang membandingkan metode induksi kelelahan secara langsung.
research_gaps.suggested_next_step: Mengembangkan protokol standar induksi kelelahan untuk memungkinkan perbandingan hasil lintas studi.

synthesis.research_question_refinement: RQ asli: fatigue. Tidak ada perubahan, karena korpus hanya mencakup satu artikel yang fokus pada kelelahan fisik selama berjalan.
subquestions: Apa parameter kinematik yang paling sensitif terhadap kelelahan fisik?
